notes: '.plugin.jar.tmp' (atomic_write::temp_path_for's own naming rule for dest 'plugin.jar') is seeded with unrelated leftover bytes, simulating a prior attempt that crashed before its rename step — the same cleanup-on-failure gap downloadLatestPaperTemplate's own catch block (line 57-58, 'Cleanup temp file on failure') exists to guard against, but here nothing ran that cleanup. Retrying stage_download must not append to or otherwise be corrupted by that stale temp file: FileSystem::write always replaces a file's full contents (fs.rs), so the retry's atomic_write call overwrites the stale temp file outright before renaming it into place, landing the destination at exactly the new download's bytes. P7.35 amendment: field renamed from 'expectedSha1Hex' to the algorithm-aware 'expectedChecksum' object; this case's own algorithm and value are unchanged.
